content.text: Perform one clear sword slash attack while facing screen-right throughout. Begin in the reference ready stance. Make a brief anticipation by shifting weight onto the rear leg and drawing the sword back. Step the front foot forward and swing the sword decisively forward across the space in front of the hero. Follow through, then recover fully to the same ready stance and foot placement. Keep the left-arm round shield attached and raised defensively. Keep the right hand closed around the same sword hilt and preserve the sword shape and length. Keep the same hair, face, blue tunic, armor, boots and proportions. Fixed camera, full body visible, no camera movement, no extra limbs, no new equipment, no magic or motion effects. Only one attack, with visible anticipation, strike, follow-through and recovery.
